# @teob/ui — LLM Quick Reference (React 19 Atomic Design System)

> Before building or modifying UI, read `.claude/skills/teob-ui/SKILL.md` for the 7-Stage Pipeline
> and craft skill orchestration (`aiforui.dev/skills` + `ui-skills.com`).

## Surface Model & CSS Layer Rules (Mandatory)
1. One plane per page: `--canvas` (root/sidebar) > `--surface-1` (main content) or `--surface-2` (sibling side panel) > `--layer-1` (Card/StatTile/table head) > `--layer-2` (muted well) > `--layer-3` (chip/pressed).
2. Never nest `Card`, `ZonedCard`, or `Section` inside another on the same plane. Group inside a card using headings, spacing, or `Disclosure`.
3. Zero raw hex literals (`#...`) in `.tsx` or `.css` files outside `tokens.css`.
4. Declare `@layer base, teob-ui;` in `index.html` `<head>` before any `<link rel="stylesheet">` or React 19 hoisted `<style precedence="default">` tags so base resets never override `@layer teob-ui` component styles.
5. Wrap the root `<App />` in `<MotionProvider><ToastProvider>...</ToastProvider></MotionProvider>` and sync `<html data-theme="light|dark" class="dark">` on theme changes.
6. **Distribution**: Prefer consuming `@teob/ui` via a `package.json` git/npm link (`"@teob/ui": "github:teob-cc/teob-ui#v0.5.0"`) with tree-shaking rather than vendoring all ~45 files or loading via runtime CDN URLs (which break Tauri `'self'` CSP and offline mode). If vendoring selectively, omit unused heavy organisms (`ChartFrame`/`recharts`, `MorphText`/`torph`) and keep `tokens.css` + bridge CSS in a theme plugin.

## Exported Modules by Atomic Layer

### 0. Utilities
- **cx** (`cx.ts`)
- **errorText** (`errorText.ts`)
- **motionEase, motionEnter, motionExit, MotionProvider, AnimatedList, AnimatedItem** (`motion.tsx`)
- **motionFeatures** (`motionFeatures.ts`)

### 1. Atoms
- **Avatar** (`Avatar.tsx`) — `{ name: string; src?: string; size?: number; className?: string }`
- **Badge** (`Badge.tsx`) — `{ children?: ReactNode; tone?: BadgeTone; dot?: boolean; className?: string; style?: CSSProperties; title?: string; 'aria-label'?: string }`
- **Button** (`Button.tsx`) — `{ children?: ReactNode; variant?: ButtonVariant; size?: ButtonSize; loading?: boolean; icon?: ReactNode; iconRight?: ReactNode }`
- **Checkbox** (`Checkbox.tsx`) — `{ checked: boolean; onChange: (checked: boolean) => void; label: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean; description?: ReactNode; className?: string }`
- **Icon** (`Icon.tsx`) — `{ name: IconName; size?: 16 | 18 | 20; label?: string; className?: string; style?: CSSProperties }`
- **InlineError** (`InlineError.tsx`)
- **Input** (`Input.tsx`) — `{ invalid?: boolean; inputSize?: 'sm' | 'md'; style?: CSSProperties; onClear?: () => void; clearLabel?: string }`
- **MorphText** (`MorphText.tsx`) — `{ children: string | number; className?: string }`
- **Kbd** (`Kbd.tsx`) — `{ children: ReactNode; className?: string }`
- **Progress** (`Progress.tsx`) — `{ value: number; tone?: ProgressTone; label?: string; className?: string }`
- **ScrollArea** (`ScrollArea.tsx`) — `{ children: ReactNode; className?: string; style?: CSSProperties; as?: 'div' | 'main' | 'nav' | 'aside' | 'section' | 'ul'; viewProps?: HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>; viewRef?: Ref<HTMLElement>; autoHeight?: boolean; maxHeight?: number | string }`
- **Select** (`Select.tsx`) — `{ options: [value: string, label: string][]; style?: CSSProperties }`
- **Skeleton** (`Skeleton.tsx`) — `{ width?: number | string; height?: number | string; radius?: number | string; className?: string; style?: CSSProperties }`
- **StatusDot** (`StatusDot.tsx`) — `{ tone?: StatusDotTone; pulse?: boolean; size?: 'sm' | 'md'; label?: string }`
- **Textarea** (`Textarea.tsx`) — `{ invalid?: boolean; style?: CSSProperties }`
- **Tooltip** (`Tooltip.tsx`) — `{ label: ReactNode; children: ReactNode; side?: TooltipSide; className?: string }`

### 2. Molecules
- **Card, CardHeader, CardContent, CardFooter, ZonedCard** (`Card.tsx`) — `{ href?: string; children: ReactNode; className?: string; padding?: number | string; variant?: 'bordered' | 'muted' | 'plain'; style?: CSSProperties }`
- **CodeBlock** (`CodeBlock.tsx`) — `{ code: string; label?: string; language?: string; maxHeight?: number | string; copy?: boolean; className?: string }`
- **Combobox** (`Combobox.tsx`) — `{ options: ComboboxOption[]; value: V; onChange: (value: V) => void; multiple?: boolean; creatable?: boolean; placeholder?: string; 'aria-label'?: string; disabled?: boolean }`
- **DescList** (`DescList.tsx`) — `{ items: DescListItem[]; className?: string }`
- **DiffView** (`DiffView.tsx`) — `{ before?: string; after?: string; lines?: DiffLine[]; className?: string }`
- **Disclosure** (`Disclosure.tsx`) — `{ summary: ReactNode; children: ReactNode; defaultOpen?: boolean; className?: string }`
- **FilterMenu** (`FilterMenu.tsx`) — `{ groups: FilterGroup[]; value: Record<string, string[]>; onChange: (value: Record<string, string[]>) => void; onClear: () => void; label?: string; defaultOpen?: boolean; className?: string }`
- **FormActions** (`FormActions.tsx`) — `{ note?: ReactNode; children: ReactNode; bare?: boolean; className?: string }`
- **Menu** (`Menu.tsx`) — `{ trigger: ReactNode; items: MenuItem[]; header?: ReactNode; align?: 'start' | 'end'; ariaLabel?: string; defaultOpen?: boolean; className?: string }`
- **Notice** (`Notice.tsx`) — `{ tone?: NoticeTone; title: ReactNode; children: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode; className?: string }`
- **Popover** (`Popover.tsx`) — `{ trigger: ReactNode; children: ReactNode; open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void; align?: 'start' | 'end'; className?: string; triggerClassName?: string; hasPopup?: 'menu' | 'dialog' | 'listbox' | true }`
- **SettingRow** (`SettingRow.tsx`) — `{ label: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; control: ReactNode; danger?: boolean; htmlFor?: string }`
- **StatTile** (`StatTile.tsx`) — `{ label: ReactNode; value: ReactNode; hint?: ReactNode; tone?: StatTone; icon?: IconName; trend?: { direction: 'up' | 'down'; label: string }; className?: string }`
- **EmptyLine, EmptyState, ErrorState, NoAccessState, LoadingRows** (`State.tsx`) — `{ title: string; children?: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode; icon?: IconName }`
- **Tabs, SegmentedControl** (`Tabs.tsx`) — `{ tabs: [key: K, label: string][]; value: K; onChange: (key: K) => void; variant?: 'underline' | 'segmented'; counts?: Partial<Record<K, number>>; 'aria-label'?: string; className?: string }`
- **toast, useToast, ToastProvider** (`Toast.tsx`)

### 3. Organisms
- **ApprovalCard** (`ApprovalCard.tsx`) — `{ title: ReactNode; risk: ApprovalRisk; meta?: ReactNode; summary?: ReactNode; children?: ReactNode; actions: ApprovalAction[]; busy?: boolean; className?: string }`
- **ChartFrame, AreaChart, BarChart** (`ChartFrame.tsx`) — `{ data: ChartDatum[]; format?: (value: number) => string; height?: number; ariaLabel: string; title?: ReactNode; summary?: ReactNode; empty?: ReactNode; className?: string }`
- **ChartPlot** (`ChartPlot.tsx`) — `{ kind: 'bar' | 'area'; data: PlotDatum[]; format: (value: number) => string; height: number; top: number; ticks: number[]; every: number }`
- **Checklist** (`Checklist.tsx`) — `{ title?: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; done: number; total: number; items: ChecklistItem[]; action?: ReactNode; className?: string }`
- **ConfirmDialog** (`ConfirmDialog.tsx`) — `{ open: boolean; onClose: () => void; onConfirm: () => void; title: string; description: ReactNode; confirmLabel: string; danger?: boolean; busy?: boolean }`
- **DataTable** (`DataTable.tsx`) — `{ rows: T[]; columns: Column<T>[]; rowKey: (row: T) => string; onRowClick?: (row: T) => void; rowClickable?: (row: T) => boolean; selectedKey?: string | null; loading?: boolean; skeletonRows?: number }`
- **DetailPanel** (`DetailPanel.tsx`) — `{ label: string; header?: ReactNode; onClose: () => void; children: ReactNode; footer?: ReactNode; width?: number; overlay?: boolean; className?: string }`
- **Dialog** (`Dialog.tsx`) — `{ open: boolean; onClose: () => void; title: string; children: ReactNode; footer?: ReactNode }`
- **PageHeader** (`PageHeader.tsx`) — `{ breadcrumb: Crumb[]; title: string; badges?: ReactNode; actions?: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; tabsBelow?: boolean; className?: string }`
- **RawPayloadModal** (`RawPayloadModal.tsx`) — `{ open: boolean; onClose: () => void; title: string; subtitle?: string; payload?: unknown; sections?: PayloadSection[] }`
- **Section** (`Section.tsx`) — `{ title: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; actions?: ReactNode; icon?: IconName; footer?: ReactNode; children: ReactNode; className?: string }`
- **Stepper** (`Stepper.tsx`) — `{ steps: StepperStep<K>[]; current: K; onSelect?: (key: K) => void; children: ReactNode; footer?: ReactNode; className?: string }`

### 4. Templates & Harnesses
- **InsetShell** (`InsetShell.tsx`) — `{ sidebar?: ReactNode; sidebarWidth?: number; children: ReactNode }`
- **Page** (`Page.tsx`) — `{ title: string; breadcrumb?: Crumb[]; badges?: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; tabs?: ReactNode; actions?: ReactNode; toolbar?: ReactNode; display?: ReactNode }`
- **PrototypeSwitcher** (`PrototypeSwitcher.tsx`) — `{ param?: string; datasetParam?: string; title?: string; options: readonly PrototypeOption<K>[]; defaultOption?: K; defaultDataset?: PrototypeDataset; showDatasetSwitch?: boolean; className?: string }`

## CLI Verification & Sync Commands (run from `teob-ui` hub)
- `node bin/teob-ui.mjs status` — check sync state across `memory-console` and `agent-mcr`
- `node bin/teob-ui.mjs audit --strict` — verify zero nested `Card`/`Section` surfaces and zero raw hex colors
- `node bin/teob-ui.mjs pull --app <name>` — sync hub updates and `llms.txt` into target app
- `node bin/teob-ui.mjs harvest <Component> --from <app> --layer <atom|molecule|organism|template>` — promote a new component to the hub
